title: 第23章 葛颜的实力第24章 你们五个被我包围了
slug: 谁让这小子升执法长老的
content_zh:
古力带着挑衅：“不够，输了还不让人说了？”
“呵！”葛颜带着嘲讽，若是在同等境界，你可不一定是他的对手。
“笑死，我古力在同辈里，从来没服过谁，就算被誉为亲传弟子的太白剑客，也不见得能在我古力身上讨得到好。”古力属实猖狂。“反倒是你，想笑死我。”
“嘴上吹炮可不顶用，进来吧，既然觉得我菜，那来演武场练练。”葛颜转身，手里提着一把剑。
“好啊，让爷看看你那个搞笑的御剑术有多少进步。”古力扛着一个大骨头，大步的走进去。
其他几个亲传弟子，紧随其后。
葛颜走在最前面，这几个人都是他邀请过来的，为的就是挽回他的面子。
现在他在亲传弟子里，已经彻底沦为笑料，还被人评价为亲传弟子最弱的一个人。
找曹立再打一场？拉倒吧，结丹境，一巴掌都给自己拍死了。
曹立可不是同门，会压制修为陪自己练练，就算是愿意压制修为，他葛颜也不是对手。
葛颜也因此自闭了两天，这才想到，踩着其他亲传弟子上位。
只要他击败了其他亲传弟子，以后大家在说他的时候，他就可以进行话题转移了，只要说，谁打不过他，就够了。
几人来了演武场。
“我先来。”古力饶有兴趣的走上演武场。
肩膀上，扛着一块半人高大的骨头，传说是上古凶兽的脚趾骨。
这块骨头太坚硬了，不管是防御还是进攻都无往不利。
同辈争斗至今，都没人能够在这块骨头上，留下一丁点痕迹。
其他亲传弟子，饶有兴趣的坐在一边看。
演武场内，古力看着葛颜：“行不行啊，那么慢，该不会是怂了吧，这可是你约我来的。”
“等着。”

葛颜提着他的剑慢吞吞的走向演武场。
“说好的，不欺负你。”古力笑着压制自己的力量，气息来到了炼体筑基境。
外面的防御这是固定的，没法变，还是结丹境的肉身防御。
“老规矩，中我一百剑，输，这次你是结丹防御，我就不用木剑了。”
“哈哈哈，直接用你的破剑吧，你有这本事就不至于被一个炼体九层打到满地找牙。”古力哈哈大笑。
“那就看看吧。”沉重的打击，让葛颜心情很差，也就没那么多话。
古力站在演武场里，等着葛颜出招。
葛颜直接大招起手，飞剑抛出，体内的灵力疯狂的倾泄而出。
飞剑不断在分裂，一千剑，两千剑，三千剑。
葛颜涨红着脸，额头和脖子，青筋暴起，剑阵继续分裂。
三千三百剑！
最终，葛颜达到了这个境界，所有的剑都在嗡鸣，似乎在兴奋。
而葛颜，维持这三千三百剑，眼珠子布满了血丝。
经过刺激，葛颜又突破了，他毕竟不是废物，而是几千万人挑一的亲传弟子。
看到三千三百剑的凌厉剑锋，古力的脸色，终于从看不起，慢慢的凝重。
上一次比试的，葛颜不过只能分裂一千五百剑，算是小成。
大成不过两千剑，与三千剑阵的圆满，威力不可同日而语。
“来啊。”古力挥舞着手中的上古凶兽骨头。
这一刻，剑阵齐出，三千三把飞剑，将古力淹没。
古力也非常的强悍，挥舞着半人高大的凶兽遗骨，砸飞了不知道多少把剑。

三千三百剑冲过之后，古力身上的皮肤，出现了少量划痕。
若是筑基境防御，此刻必定伤痕累累。
葛颜又操控的三千飞剑，再来一轮。
content_en:
Guli said provocatively: "It's not enough. Why don't we let people talk about it if we lose?"
"Ha!" Ge Yan said sarcastically. If you were in the same realm, you may not be his opponent.
"It's funny, I, Gu Li, have never obeyed anyone among my peers. Even Taibai Swordsman, who is known as his direct disciple, may not be able to get good treatment from me, Gu Li." Gu Li is really arrogant. "On the contrary, you want to laugh me to death."
"It's no use talking about it. Come on in. Since you think I'm good, come to the martial arts field to practice." Ge Yan turned around, holding a sword in his hand.
"Okay, let me see how much progress your funny sword-driving skills have made." Gu Li strode in with a big bone on his shoulders.
Several other direct disciples followed closely behind.
Ge Yan walked in the front. He invited these people here to save his face.
Now he has completely become a laughing stock among his direct disciples, and is even evaluated as the weakest person among his direct disciples.
Want to have another fight with Cao Li? Pull him down, he is in the Dan Formation Realm. He can even slap himself to death.
Cao Li was not from the same sect and would suppress his cultivation to practice with him. Even if he was willing to suppress his cultivation, he, Ge Yan, was no match.
Ge Yan was autistic for two days because of this, and then he thought of stepping on other direct disciples to ascend to the throne.
As long as he defeats other direct disciples, when everyone talks about him in the future, he can change the topic. Just say who can't beat him, that's enough.
Several people came to the martial arts arena.
"I'll go first." Gu Li walked into the martial arts arena with great interest.
On his shoulders, he carried a tall half-human bone, which was said to be the toe bone of an ancient ferocious beast.
This bone is so hard that it is invincible whether it is defense or offense.
Even in the fight between peers, no one has been able to leave a single trace on this bone.
The other direct disciples sat and watched with interest.
In the martial arts arena, Gu Li looked at Ge Yan: "Can you do it? I'm so slow. I guess I'm scared. You invited me here."
"Wait."
Ge Yan slowly walked towards the martial arts arena with his sword in hand.
"I promised that I won't bully you." Gu Li suppressed his power with a smile, and his breath came to the body refining and foundation building realm.
The external defense is fixed and cannot be changed. It is still the physical defense of the Dan Formation Realm.
"The old rule is, if you hit me with a hundred swords, you lose. This time you are using elixir for defense, so I won't use the wooden sword."
"Hahaha, just use your broken sword. If you have this ability, you won't be beaten to the ground by a ninth-level body refiner." Gu Li laughed.
"Then let's take a look." The heavy blow made Ge Yan feel very bad, so he didn't say much.
Gu Li stood in the martial arts arena, waiting for Ge Yan to make a move.
Ge Yan directly raised his hand, threw the flying sword, and the spiritual power in his body poured out crazily.
The flying swords are constantly splitting, one thousand swords, two thousand swords, three thousand swords.
Ge Yan's face turned red, veins popped out on his forehead and neck, and the sword array continued to split.
Three thousand three hundred swords!
Finally, Ge Yan reached this state, and all the swords were buzzing and seemed to be excited.
As for Ge Yan, maintaining these 3,300 swords, his eyes were bloodshot.
After being stimulated, Ge Yan made another breakthrough. After all, he was not a waste, but a direct disciple chosen from tens of millions of people.
Seeing the sharp edge of the Three Thousand Three Hundred Sword, Gu Li's expression finally changed from looking down to become solemn.
In the last competition, Ge Yan could only split 1,500 swords, which was considered a small success.
The great achievement is only two thousand swords, and the power of the three thousand sword array is not comparable to that of the three thousand swords.
"Come on." Gu Li waved the ancient beast bones in his hand.
At this moment, the sword array came out, and three thousand three flying swords overwhelmed Gu Li.
Guli was also very powerful. He wielded the half-man tall ferocious beast bones and smashed countless swords away.
After the three thousand three hundred swords rushed through, a few scratches appeared on Gu Li's skin.
If it were a foundation-building defense, there would definitely be scars at this moment.tired.
Ge Yan controlled the three thousand flying swords for another round.
